reviews.text:
I am extremely disappointed by the lack of compassion shown by this practice.
A friend found a stray cat in an appalling condition with a serious eye injury and obvious signs that it urgently needed veterinary care. When she contacted this practice for help, she was told they would only see the cat if she registered it as her own and agreed to pay for treatment and that it's not their responsibility.  The member of staff was also rude and dismissive throughout the conversation.
Thankfully another veterinary practice stepped in and provided the urgent care the cat desperately needed.
I understand that veterinary practice is a business but I expected concern for an animal that was clearly suffering and respectful advice for someone trying to do the right thing. Instead, we were met with indifference and a complete lack of empathy. Looks like a money making machine and they don't care about suffering animals.  They have duty of care which was refused to this poor baby in need.
This experience has seriously damaged my confidence in this practice. This practice is a disgrace!
Edit: to answer your response.  Yes same feedback was left for other practice because you were both very bad and pretty much said the same thing when my friend, but in fact you were worse. All you care about is money and not helping animal in need.  You said you would take him in if she pay for consultation and treatment so you weren't fully booked in if someone pays?!! Disgusting behaviour

Awful practice and manager. My cat has been coming to this practice from a young age. After visiting them for a blood test, she came home and couldn’t even walk or bear weight on her hind legs after handling from the nurses. They refuse to accept any accountability and all they care about is money.
Lovely staff

Absolutely lovely place!
Staff are so kind they loved my dog as much as I love her!
Would definitely recommend!
My baby is on the mend now can’t thank you enough!!! X

They are too expensive. The receptionists are more of ignorants as they kind of don’t like you if you are speaking broken English. one of the Vets the guy with earring wouldn’t listen to you instead he likes to make fun of your ideas. Not professional at all.
They provide absolutely zero advice or training to you instead keep you in null so they can charge you as much as they can. The care plan they encourage you to purchase is stupid do not get it as they make up situation for you to use your nurse and Vet visit balances.
Never had a bad experience and staff have always been friendly

my dog has always gone to this practice so when he was dieing I took him there and was quoted 390 pounds to put him to sleep and a cremation
I explained this was very expensive as vets for pets in West Bromwich quoted 174 pounds
I was told its a different franchise so I went from quinton to West Bromwich vets for pets I think they are 5 star
and when I buy another dog I will go to West Bromwich

Can’t give any lower than 5 my kitten just had his operation here and the nurse in the morning was so calming and amazing. She reassured me and I could instantly tell stewie was In the best care possible. Amazing place if you are looking for the vet I would a million percent recommend this place to take your pet. The receptionists are very sweet and welcoming. Can’t say this enough thank you so much for taking care of stewie ❤️

Highly recommend this vets. As a first time cat owner they have answered all of my questions and given me so much support which has made me feel more confident as a cat owner. Every receptionist I’ve spoken to has been extremely helpful, and the vets and nursing staff are incredible. They have always accommodated with appointments to fit around my work and have booked us in at short notice when I have had concerns for my cat. Wouldn’t go anywhere else. Thank you team!

Ive used this paticular vets for years priced have gone up but so has everything ese..receptionists really luverly my dogs love them ..thr surgery they do fantastic..last surgery was with my little dogs teeth he was running around a few hours later.....
Great vets. Good advice, recommended

2 stars just for the lady at reception she’s very disrespectful when she saw I didn’t want vaccine for my cat. She started make fan me at me and she may give me luck 🤞🏼very disrespectful to my cat doesn’t die just because they want to charge for the vaccine otherwise they don’t do nothing else. …

I highly recommend Vets for Pets. Every staff member, from receptionists to the owner, demonstrates exceptional professionalism, expertise, and genuine care for pets and their owners.
Dr Badr El Alaoui is an outstanding vet. He gave my cat the most thorough and compassionate examination, noticing every detail with remarkable precision. He reviewed my elderly cat’s notes carefully and demonstrated an exceptional understanding of her medications, their interactions, and potential effects. He spent so much time observing her behaviour, explaining everything clearly, and provided research-based leaflets that helped me understand her condition and future care needs. He was also incredibly empathetic and reassuring to me throughout the visit. His expertise, dedication, and compassion are truly exceptional. I couldn’t recommend him more highly.
Nurse Morgan Goring is an excellent nurse. She is patient. Professional. Understanding and a phantom of knowledge
Very helpful staff, my cat loves going to the these vets. Emily (I believe) is so nice with us and my cat loves her too
Very quick appointments excellent advice and care for my dog

Overall, I’ve been happy with the vets I’ve seen at Vets for Pets in Quinton. However, the experience with the reception team has not been the same unfortunately. There’s one receptionist in particular who is very blunt on the phone. She interrupts while you’re speaking, talks over you, and comes off quite rude. She’s also not very upfront about the costs involved when asked and tends to be quite critical rather than helpful. I think some training would really help. On a more positive note, there’s another receptionist with red/ginger hair who’s usually lovely – she’s friendly and a lot more approachable. It makes a big difference.

I would never use this practice every again.  They are all about the money.  Pointless tests  done on my cat when she would never have been able to have her tumour removed due to it's placement but I was gaslit as I dared to question why they were doing it.   It was the most horrible experience.
I wish I'd trusted my gut.   Complete lack of empathy.

The worst experience I have ever had after my dog was put to sleep. This practice takes simple questions, won't answer them, lie and call it harassment when you keep asking questions. Asked to speak to owner and I have never heard back. Unhinged and one to avoid.

Just called for some pricing, trainee on the desk which I understand, but telephone manner isn't good, put me through to someone else who was the opposite, very sharp, rude attitude on the phone, won't be going there as to me that shows how you would treat my pet!
The staff are always lovely and helpfuf.
Very expensive

Don't use this vets they charged me £50 / £70 for a tiny bottle of eye drops
£3 at chemist for human ones !
Ask for the manager to be told not there and never heard off them again
only reason I left it was cause it was  treatment for my dog
Great
Absolutely  fabulous nurse appointment and managed to get to see a vet aswell thank you so much

I want to start my review by saying that the receptionists and nurses that we dealt with were fantastic. They were empathetic, friendly, and welcoming.

However, one of the vets we met with disappointed us considerably. We took our rabbit to the vet as she needed surgery to remove a mass. We were very anxious about this, and knew nothing about it. The vet we saw rushed through her consultation, recommended an extremely expensive surgery with zero explanation, and showed an absolute lack of empathy or compassion. We were appalled at the service we received and have now changed vets. It’s a great shame as the rest of the staff are lovely. We simply did not feel as if our pet’s best interests were at heart. So if your pet is in need, I strongly advise against visiting this practice.
Great service as always. Fast and friendly. Clear with communication and above all caring for our pet and keeping us worry free :)
Very very caring..

I came in to get my dog spayed today in which I was already nervous but they was all so friendly towards the dog and did not forget her as being a big dog some people are wary of her but they was lovely to the animals and the owners. Thankyou so much
